title: Google\Cloud\AutoMl\V1\OutputConfig
name: OutputConfig
description:
• For Translation: CSV file translation.csv, with each line in format: ML_USE,GCS_FILE_PATH GCS_FILE_PATH leads to a .TSV file which describes examples that have given ML_USE, using the following row format per line: TEXT_SNIPPET (in source language) \t TEXT_SNIPPET (in target language)
    • For Tables: Output depends on whether the dataset was imported from Google Cloud Storage or BigQuery.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.gcs_destination
params.description: Required. The Google Cloud Storage location where the output is to be written to. For Image Object Detection, Text Extraction, Video Classification and Tables, in the given directory a new directory will be created with name: export_data-- where timestamp is in YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ ISO-8601 format. All export output will be written into that directory.

methods.name: getGcsDestination
methods.description: Required. The Google Cloud Storage location where the output is to be written to.

methods.name: setGcsDestination
methods.description: Required. The Google Cloud Storage location where the output is to be written to.
